# Model Rankings

## Ready for Promotion
| Rank | Model | Task | Instrument | Expectancy (16w/4w) | Sharpe (16w/4w) | ExcessReturn | Ops (30d) | DD (IS/OOS) | cecpp (16w/4w) | Score (16w) | Confidence |
|------|-------|------|------------|---------------------|-----------------|--------------|-----------|-------------|----------------|-------------|------------|
| 1 | `[[model/4a4d8f30]]` | `[[task/7e387dd3]]` | `[[instrument/XLE]]` | `$2.80 / $3.37` | `2.10 / 1.01` | `16w -22.36%`, `30d OOS -7.55%`, `SC -2.19%` | `86` | `17.20% / 1.98%` | `0.957 / 0.419` | `0.808` | `Medium (live)` |

Ready notes:
- `[[model/4a4d8f30]]` is `ACTIVE` in `[[portfolio/paper-alpha-01]]` at `5%`. Two filled buy orders: `13 XLE @ $61.07` (Mar 26 13:31) and `1 XLE @ $61.77` (Mar 26 17:45). Total position: `14 XLE`.
- 16w eval trend: `0.747 → 0.772 → 0.784 → 0.783 → 0.805 → 0.808` (6 evals, improving). All 6 above the `0.58` floor.
- 4w eval trend: `0.411 → 0.413 → 0.444 → 0.458 → 0.483` (improving). Still slightly below `0.58` on 4w, but the stat profile is strong (4w sharpe `1.009`, exp `$3.37`).
- 8w score dipped to `0.583` on Mar 26 (from `0.631`). 16w stable → classified as noise, not degradation.
- Since-created: sharpe `1.526`, exp `$4.32`, np `$120.98`, ops `52`, DD `1.02%`.
- No sell orders yet, so no closed round-trip from live execution. First closed profit is the key milestone to watch.

## Monitoring (Promotion Path)
| Model | Task | Instrument | Expectancy (16w/4w) | Sharpe (16w/4w) | Ops (30d) | DD (IS/OOS) | Score (16w) | Next Review |
|-------|------|------------|---------------------|-----------------|-----------|-------------|-------------|-------------|
| `[[model/430002c9]]` | `[[task/880c9eb3]]` | `[[instrument/XLE]]` | `$4.05 / $5.68` | `1.81 / 1.17` | `135` | `22.19% / 4.27%` | `0.823` | `Need 5/5 stable (4/5 now) + since_created np > $0` |

Promotion path notes:
- `[[model/430002c9]]` is the **only** monitoring candidate that passes the IS DD `< 25%` gate (IS DD `22.19%`, headroom `2.81%`).
- 16w eval trend: `0.795 → 0.797 → 0.832 → 0.823` (4/5 stable, all above `0.58`). Should reach 5/5 tomorrow.
- 4w eval trend: `0.419 → 0.453 → 0.497 → 0.525` (improving). 8w dipped to `0.618` on Mar 26 (from `0.708`) — noise pattern (16w stable).
- 30d OOS backtest (Feb 24–Mar 25): sharpe `1.048`, exp `$4.24`, np `$318.11`, ops `141`, wr `89.3%`, DD `4.27%`, cecpp `0.870`, excess `-2.46%`.
- Since-created: sharpe `0.311`, exp `$0`, np `$0`, tpnl `$84.05`, ops `7`. **The sole remaining blocker is post-creation closed-profit conversion.**
- If since-created net_profit turns positive and the 5th stable eval lands, this model is promotable.

## Monitoring (IS DD Blocked — Strong Edge, Cannot Promote)
| Model | Task | Instrument | Expectancy (16w/4w) | Sharpe (16w/4w) | Ops (30d OOS) | IS DD | OOS DD | 30d OOS Sharpe | Score (16w) | Evals |
|-------|------|------------|---------------------|-----------------|---------------|-------|--------|----------------|-------------|-------|
| `[[model/e97b2a73]]` | `[[task/73489ab7]]` | `[[instrument/XLE]]` | `$33.65 / $13.12` | `2.32 / 1.22` | `51` | `27.37%` | `5.20%` | `1.143` | `0.924` | `3/5` |
| `[[model/d6f756a8]]` | `[[task/8269132d]]` | `[[instrument/XLE]]` | `$24.30 / $30.52` | `1.98 / 1.18` | `42` | `28.34%` | `5.44%` | `1.105` | `0.840` | `4/5` |
| `[[model/bd7f81f2]]` | `[[task/8269132d]]` | `[[instrument/XLE]]` | `$5.30 / $5.43` | `2.19 / 1.40` | `118` | `26.13%` | `4.57%` | `1.282` | `0.805` | `7+` |
| `[[model/f15cb94d]]` | `[[task/66461b8d]]` | `[[instrument/XLE]]` | `$12.10 / $11.67` | `2.55 / 1.21` | `39` | `28.37%` | `5.89%` | `1.254` | `0.814` | `1/5` |

IS DD blocked notes:
- **All four models have excellent OOS edge profiles** (30d OOS sharpe > 1.0, positive expectancy, low OOS DD) but IS DD > 25% permanently blocks promotion under current shared config.
- These models demonstrate that XLE optimization produces strong OOS strategies that happen to have high IS drawdowns.
- `[[model/bd7f81f2]]` showed a V-shaped 16w recovery: `0.707 → 0.737 → 0.793 → 0.805`. 4w is the strongest at `0.605`.
- **Stat-profile-feedback sent to Strategist** on this systemic IS DD problem.

## Early Watch
| Model | Task | Instrument | Score | Created | Note |
|-------|------|------------|-------|---------|------|
| `[[model/c6cd47ea]]` | `[[task/02c1c566]]` (EXP-53) | `[[instrument/XLE]]` | `0.607` | `2026-03-26` | First EXP-53 model above score floor. Only 1 eval; no stored eval stats yet. |
| `[[model/779f88d5]]` | `[[task/038c01ca]]` (EXP-36 GLD) | `[[instrument/GLD]]` | `0.531` | `2026-03-26` | Below score floor. |
| `[[model/6870f1e7]]` | `[[task/880c9eb3]]` | `[[instrument/XLE]]` | `0.486` | `2026-03-10` | Score-suppressed realized converter. SC np `$503.57`, sharpe `1.383`. Below score floor but proves converter edge. |

## Degrading (Action Needed)
| Model | Task | Instrument | Expectancy Trend | Sharpe Trend | ExcessReturn | Ops Trend | DD Trend | Live? | Recommendation |
|-------|------|------------|------------------|--------------|--------------|-----------|----------|-------|----------------|
| `[[model/15ef0ccd]]` | `[[task/7e387dd3]]` | `[[instrument/XLE]]` | `$46.20 (16w) → $0.00 (4w/1w/SC)` | `2.29 → 1.02 → 0.84 → 0.41` | `16w -13.35%, SC -0.52%` | `56 → 24 → 1 → 1` | `3.79% → 3.80%` | No | Confirmed dead. No recent conversion. |
| `[[model/50386221]]` | `[[task/f29a02cc]]` | `[[instrument/GLD]]` | `$36.21 (16w) → -$41.03 (8w) → $0.00 (SC)` | `0.38 → -1.14` | `16w -3.17%` | `44 → 10` | `12.57%` | No | Failed. |
| `[[model/6eaa64dd]]` | `[[task/9ac8eba0]]` | `[[instrument/GLD]]` | `$49.17 (16w) → $0.00 (SC)` | `0.37 → -1.39` | `16w -1.27%` | `53 → 6` | `22.74%` | No | Failed. |

## Summary
- Total models surveyed: `230` (`1` new since last run: `[[model/c6cd47ea]]` from EXP-53)
- Stat-profile candidates (strong edge + activity): `6` (but only `2` pass IS DD gate)
- Newly promoted candidates: `0` (pipeline bottleneck: since-created conversion + IS DD)
- IS DD blocked models: `4` (e97b2a73, d6f756a8, bd7f81f2, f15cb94d — all > 25%)
- Degrading models flagged: `3`
- Stat-profile feedback sent to Strategist: **yes** — IS DD systemic blocking across 3 tasks
- Live model `[[model/4a4d8f30]]`: healthy, improving, first paper trades executing
- Pipeline successor: `[[model/430002c9]]` — the only IS DD-clear candidate, 4/5 stable, awaiting since-created conversion
